source_text: Quinque reges in spelunca Mageda absconditi — obstruite speluncam. Post victoriam educuntur et pedibus principum calcantur — hostes spiritales sub pedibus. Suspenduntur in lignis usque ad vesperam. Gloria Iesu. Amen.
pass_a_gloss: Five kings in cave Makkedah hidden — block cave. After victory they-are-led-out and by-feet of-leaders are-trampled — enemies spiritual under feet. They-are-hung on woods until evening. Glory to-Jesus. Amen.
pass_b_english: [[Five kings hide in the cave at Makkedah — seal the cave >> Bible:Joshua 10:16-18]]. After victory they are brought out and captains set feet on their necks — spiritual foes underfoot. [[They are hanged on trees until evening >> Bible:Joshua 10:26]]. Glory to Jesus. Amen.
